runners_data.name: Mento

runners_data.name: L'As de Watt
runners_data.note: Has shown best form on good ground and holds strong second-place form at Cork previously
runners_data.spotlight: Ran respectably behind odds-on favourite I'm Slippy when 66-1 second in a 2m Cork maiden hurdle last November; no impact over 2m4f at Killarney after a break.

runners_data.name: Facile Ocean
runners_data.note: Prominent type with decent recent form, handicap mark suggests ability but needs to settle better
runners_data.comment: Keen when third of four on bumper debut; well beaten in two runs for this yard
runners_data.spotlight: Favourite for four-runner bumper on debut in sole start for Tom Mullins but was too keen and finished third; two moderate runs in bumpers for this stable before a much-improved display when second at this venue 16 days ago on his hurdling debut; jumping was fine, needs to settle better.

runners_data.name: Gunnery Sergeant
runners_data.note: Elliott hold-up horse with placed form in maidens, needs pace collapse to be effective from rear
runners_data.comment: Runner-up in two maiden hurdles; ran just ok on chase debut lto; needs plenty more
runners_data.spotlight: Runner-up in two maiden hurdles this year, although the value of the form is questionable; well beaten over fences on his last two starts, prominent before weakening from two out at this venue last time; definite chance in a race of this standard

runners_data.name: Captain Hanley
runners_data.note: Former flat maiden who showed promise on hurdling debut, hold-up style suits if pace is strong
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden on the Flat after 18 attempts, rated a lowly 51; now looks a different proposition after a promising introduction to hurdling at Clonmel; despite suffering interference, stayed on well over a similar trip to this, form strongly advertised by the winner Minella Diamond in winning easily at Limerick on Thursday

runners_data.name: Imarajan
runners_data.note: Flat-bred hold-up horse with moderate hurdling form, needs everything to fall right from the back
runners_data.comment: 65-rated Flat maiden, stays 1m6f, poor run in a maiden hurdle last time, handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: 65-rated Flat maiden, stayed 1m6f, placed at the Curragh last October on his final start for the Hartys; remote fourth in a maiden hurdle at Wexford in April on first start for the stable; new headgear combination.

runners_data.name: Mighty Berkshire
runners_data.note: Long absence since November and has struggled over fences recently, hard to recommend
runners_data.comment: Placed in one of his maiden hurdles; tailed off over fences the last twice
runners_data.spotlight: Third in a six-runner maiden hurdle over 3m1f at this venue last summer; two moderate runs over fences before last November down the field in a handicap hurdle at Limerick at Christmas and absent since.

runners_data.name: Beacon Bypass
runners_data.note: Consistent disappointment across multiple disciplines, well beaten in recent maiden hurdle attempts
runners_data.comment: Well beaten in a point, bumper and sole hurdles start; that form won't be enough
runners_data.spotlight: Well beaten in a point, a bumper and two maiden hurdles starts; no apparent chance.

races.paceDynamic: Allroadsleadtorome is the only confirmed front-runner and will lead uncontested, setting his own tempo over this 2m3f trip. With no pace pressure, he can dictate throughout and potentially steal the race if maintaining stamina. The large field of 15 will string out behind him, with prominent racers like Mento, L'As de Watt and Facile Ocean tracking, while the hold-up horses including Gunnery Sergeant, Captain Hanley and Imarajan will need the pace to collapse late. This uncontested lead scenario strongly favours front-running and prominent tactics, as the hold-up brigade may find themselves with too much to do.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Allroadsleadtorome gets an easy lead and stays the trip
scenarios.body: He can dictate fractions and kick clear when the field comes under pressure, with prominent trackers left chasing. The lack of early pace pressure allows front-runners to preserve energy for the finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes steady and prominent horses can close late
scenarios.body: Mento, L'As de Watt or Facile Ocean can track the leader and pounce when he weakens in the final stages. Their positioning gives them the tactical edge over hold-up horses who are too far back.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Charge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If Allroadsleadtorome goes too fast early and burns out
scenarios.body: The Elliott-trained Gunnery Sergeant or Captain Hanley can come from off the pace to pick up the pieces. This requires the leader to set unsustainable fractions that create a collapse scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Maiden Shock Victory
scenarios.trigger: If the experienced horses all disappoint and a newcomer finds improvement
scenarios.body: One of the lightly-raced debutants like Robindeepot or The Red Lad could spring a surprise with natural jumping ability. This scenario requires multiple market leaders to underperform simultaneously.

watchPoints.text: Watch Allroadsleadtorome at the start - if he breaks cleanly and gets an easy lead, he becomes very dangerous
Monitor the pace through the first mile - if it's too steady, it will favour the hold-up horses late
Check how Facile Ocean settles early - his tendency to be too keen could undermine his chances
Watch for market support for the Hanlon debutants The Red Lad and Sonna Lady indicating stable confidence
Observe Gunnery Sergeant's position turning in - he needs to be within striking distance to use his finishing kick

races.name: Gannon Eco Novice Hurdle

runners_data.name: Local News

runners_data.comment: Homebred by Malinas is half-sister to 2m5f chase winner

runners_data.name: Master Haku
runners_data.note: Solid maiden hurdle winner but disappointed last time at longer trip, proven at this venue gives confidence

runners_data.name: Lemmy Caution
runners_data.note: Finally broke maiden hurdle duck at Punchestown but poor effort since raises doubts about consistency

runners_data.name: Pets Georgina
runners_data.note: Unseated on hurdles debut just six days ago, very quick turnaround for inexperienced hurdler
runners_data.comment: Long odds and soundly beaten in both bumpers, much more needed on hurdles' bow
runners_data.spotlight: Modest form so far in two bumpers and was hampered and unseated at the third on hurdles debut at Ballinrobe just six days ago when she was a 33-1 shot; still early days but hard to make a case for on form.

runners_data.name: Red Or White
runners_data.note: Winless over hurdles in seven attempts but consistent place record suggests reliable each-way chance
runners_data.comment: Best of six runs came here over 2m1f, off since August, place chance if fit after break
runners_data.spotlight: 0-7 over hurdles and rated 94; has shown ability in maiden hurdles but the closest she's got to the winner was when beaten 6.75l into third of 9 at Sligo (2m4f, good) last time; should be sharper for that first run back after a break but steps into the unknown here trip wise; others appeal more.

races.paceDynamic: Pets Georgina and Red Or White will contest the early pace as the only confirmed front runners in this small field. With both lacking recent winning form, they're unlikely to go excessively fast but will establish an honest gallop over the 3-mile trip. The prominent runners Local News, Master Haku, and Lemmy Caution will track behind this modest pace, setting up a tactical finish where horses with finishing kicks can strike late. This moderate tempo strongly favours hold-up horses and those with tactical speed who can position prominently and finish strongly.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the front runners maintain a steady but undemanding gallop
scenarios.body: The prominent trio can track the pace comfortably and use their superior class to kick clear in the final furlong. Local News and Master Haku have the ratings and recent form to capitalise on this tactical scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes pedestrian and creates a sprint finish
scenarios.body: Horses held up or racing patiently can unleash late runs to catch the leaders in the final 100 yards. This suits runners with proven finishing kicks who can benefit from the slow tempo.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runners Steal It
scenarios.trigger: If Pets Georgina and Red Or White go too slow and maintain their lead
scenarios.body: The pace-setters can control the race from the front and hold on grimly to the line. Red Or White's consistency in hurdle races gives her the best chance of this scenario playing out.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Collapse of Favourites
scenarios.trigger: If Local News and Master Haku fail to fire as expected
scenarios.body: The race opens up for the outsiders to claim an upset result. This scenario relies on the market leaders underperforming significantly below their ratings and recent form.

watchPoints.text: Pets Georgina has only six days recovery from her hurdles debut fall and could be ring-rusty or lack confidence at the obstacles
Master Haku weakened badly when stepped up to 2m4f last time and this 3-mile trip may stretch his stamina further
Local News carries just 150lbs compared to 164lbs for the Elliott pair, giving her a significant weight advantage
Red Or White has never won over hurdles despite nine attempts but her front-running style could steal a march if the pace collapses
Gordon Elliott's 14-day strike rate of 13% suggests both his runners may need the run despite recent form

races.paceDynamic: Blue Reed and Not So Serious are the confirmed front-runners who will set the early gallop, with both having shown keen tendencies and forward positioning. Blue Reed has more consistent form but both are capable of establishing an honest pace over this 2m3f trip. With limited early pace and 15 runners, the gallop is likely to be moderate rather than searching, allowing the field to stay bunched for longer. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce late finishing kicks, as the steady early tempo will leave plenty in reserve for the closing stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Moderate Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If the two front-runners Blue Reed and Not So Serious set only a modest gallop through the early stages
scenarios.body: The field stays compact allowing hold-up horses to conserve energy and unleash decisive late runs. Horses like Sheer Raz, Justicialism and Finnicky Filly can time their challenges perfectly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front-Runners Battle Early
scenarios.trigger: If Blue Reed and Not So Serious engage in a genuine speed duel from the start
scenarios.body: Their early battle creates a strong gallop that sets up the race for prominent racers who can avoid the pace battle. Kalsman and Brother Hollie benefit from tracking the leaders without participating in their duel.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Surprise Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If both Blue Reed and Not So Serious fail to lead or show their usual early speed
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical crawl with no genuine pace, turning into a sprint finish. The most progressive and well-handicapped horses can capitalize regardless of running style.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Meltdown
scenarios.trigger: If the early leaders set such a slow pace that the race becomes a messy scramble
scenarios.body: Positioning becomes crucial and any horse finding clear room can capitalize in a chaotic finish. Long shots with tactical speed like Rajjnatin or Annie's Belle could emerge from the pack.

watchPoints.text: Blue Reed and Not So Serious both have documented fade tendencies which could see them tire dramatically if they set strong early pace
Sekifi ran poorly at Limerick on Thursday and quick turnaround may compound fitness concerns
Sheer Raz applies tongue-tie for first time which could unlock improvement from consistent recent efforts
Several horses including Inches Away and Glaoinn An Airgead return from lengthy breaks and may need the run
Multiple runners including Anodandawink, Justicialism and Rajjnatin show clear patterns of fading in the closing stages

races.paceDynamic: Premier Rogue will take the field along from the front with minimal pressure, given only Walk Win shows any early speed preference and he tends to fade. Le Diablo, Diamond Secret, and the majority of the field will settle in behind, creating a large hold-up pack tracking a moderate gallop. The sustainable pace will set up a cavalry charge from the back straight, with stamina and finishing kick becoming paramount over track position. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses with proven finishing speed, as they'll get the perfect setup to unleash their kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Premier Rogue gets an easy lead and finds extra when challenged
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows him to conserve energy for a sustained finish, while the hold-up brigade leaves their runs too late on the testing ground. His prominent style proves optimal when he's not hassled early.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly crawling and multiple hold-up horses produce finishing kicks
scenarios.body: The slow gallop becomes a sprint finish where the best finishers with tactical speed prevail over horses who've had to do the donkey work. Le Diablo and Secret Rock benefit most from being fresh for their final efforts.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Premier Rogue stops and Walk Win also fades early, creating chaos
scenarios.body: The lack of any genuine pace-setting leaves the race at the mercy of whoever can sustain a long run from the back. This tactical mess favours horses with versatility rather than pure finishing speed.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Benzine Chase Form
scenarios.trigger: If Benzine's recent chasing improvement translates back over hurdles with tactical positioning
scenarios.body: His excellent second over fences suggests significant improvement, and if positioned closer than usual, he could exploit the weak pace with a sustained challenge. The form boost gives him an edge over similarly rated rivals.

watchPoints.text: Premier Rogue's early position will dictate the entire race shape - if he gets an uncontested lead the hold-up horses face a tactical nightmare
Walk Win's tendency to fade combined with cheekpieces could see him stop suddenly if prominent early, disrupting the pace flow
Le Diablo's dramatic 33-1 improvement last time needs confirmation but his hold-up style suits the likely race development perfectly
Several runners including High Notions, I Feel Fine and Benzine show patterns of fading in the finish despite being held up
Secret Rock's 300-day absence and stable switch makes him hard to assess but his flat wins suggest he retains ability

runners_data.name: Jackson Lamb
runners_data.note: Natural leader with back-to-back wins but 219 days off and failed badly in Grade 2 company last time
runners_data.spotlight: Won back to back races last summer, a Bellewstown maiden hurdle (20.5f, good) and a Kelso novice (2m5f, good); out of depth in Cheltenham Grade 2 novice hurdle when last seen in October; not bred for this game and probably best watched after a 219-day absence.

runners_data.name: Howdoyalikeherhome
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse from powerful Elliott yard but pulled up twice when last seen and needs to prove wellbeing
runners_data.comment: Up 4lb for Down Royal win last month, drops in trip, this a tougher race, place claims
runners_data.spotlight: Placed in a couple of points; 1-16 over hurdles and rated 119 in that sphere; however, was pulled up in successive races at Galway and Killarney when last seen last August and while there's a good chance he'll make a chaser on breeding, he's tended to need his comeback runs in the past.

runners_data.name: Chichester Park
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with decent recent hurdles form and trip should suit but trainer out of form
runners_data.comment: M'den hurdle winner needs to improve over his two h'cap starts
runners_data.spotlight: Point winner is 1-6 over hurdles and rated 115; not a bad effort over 2m in a handicap hurdle at Punchestown latest and shaped like further would suit; dam related to a couple of useful chasers and yard coming into form; could go well.

runners_data.name: Billie Frechette
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare with proven chase form and lightest weight but disappointing latest effort
runners_data.comment: Flat and hurdle winner ran well enough on chase bow at Kilbeggan and can be involved
runners_data.spotlight: Dual-purpose Flat winner; 1-6 over hurdles and rated 120; promise in first two chase attempts, earning a rating of 117; beaten 17l into second of 12 behind talented Supersundae here (22.5f, gd-yld) in April; 9l fourth of 10 at Killarney (2m5f, gd-yld) 22 days ago; leading claims.

runners_data.name: Londonofficecallin
runners_data.note: Prominent runner fresh from Flat success but inconsistent hurdler making chase debut
runners_data.comment: Won a 1m6f conditions race and two races over hurdles in 2025, lacks a recent outing
runners_data.spotlight: Dual-purpose sort; a winner of six races on the Flat, including the Cork Derby on latest (1m4f, soft) on first run back after a break; 4-28 over hurdles and rated 120; makes a belated chase debut at the age of nine but not bred for this discipline; in good form right now though and can't be discounted.

runners_data.name: Jane Eire
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse from top yard but 217 days off after two poor chase efforts
runners_data.spotlight: 1-8 over hurdles and rated 118; modest efforts in first two chases at Fairyhouse when beaten 17l and Wexford when beaten 40l, both last October; off since and this is an easier race; yard continues in hot form so she can't be discounted.

runners_data.name: Boston Rajj
runners_data.note: Prominent runner better at longer trips making chase debut for claiming jockey
runners_data.spotlight: Exposed hurdler 1-14 in that sphere and rated 113; his win came over 3m2f but he's effective at this shorter trip; however, not an obvious candidate for chasing on breeding and lacks a recent run; others appeal more.

runners_data.name: Mister Frostie
runners_data.note: Front runner but pulled up twice in hunter chases and clearly outclassed
runners_data.comment: Hard to fancy on the form of his run since returning to Colin McBratney
runners_data.spotlight: Point-to-point winner; 0-6 over hurdles and rated 103; pulled up and beaten 72l in Downpatrick maiden hunter chases the last twice; others make more appeal.

runners_data.name: Something Noble
runners_data.note: Prominent local runner with decent hurdles form but making chase debut at just four years old
runners_data.comment: Juvenile hurdle winner last year won a Limerick h'cap on return; a player up 6lb
runners_data.spotlight: Locally trained 4yo; Killarney maiden hurdle winner last July (2m1f, yld-sft); added a Limerick handicap hurdle off 112 in March (2m, soft); tailed off on latest at Bellewstown and now switches attention to chasing; would probably prefer softer ground.

races.paceDynamic: Jackson Lamb, Apple's Of Bresil, and Mister Frostie will ensure a strong gallop from the start, with all three confirmed front runners likely to dispute the early lead. The pace will be testing throughout this 2m4½f trip, particularly with Apple's Of Bresil and Jackson Lamb both proven winners who won't give an inch. This sustained gallop will stretch the field and expose any fitness doubts after long layoffs. The relentless pace strongly favours hold-up horses and prominent racers with tactical speed, as the early leaders will likely weaken in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Benefit
scenarios.trigger: If the three front runners go too fast early and burn each other out
scenarios.body: The strong pace will set up perfectly for closers like Howdoyalikeherhome and Jane Eire who can pick up the pieces. Gordon Elliott's Howdoyalikeherhome has the class edge with a 119 hurdles rating despite the poor last two runs.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If one horse can sit just behind the pace and kick at the right moment
scenarios.body: Boston Rajj or Something Noble could track the leaders without getting embroiled in the early battle. Their tactical positioning allows them to strike when the front runners weaken in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Jackson Lamb can dictate a more sensible pace and outstay his rivals
scenarios.body: His back-to-back wins last summer show he has the class to control the race from the front. If he can avoid a speed duel with Apple's Of Bresil, his stamina will prove decisive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos Benefits Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses make jumping errors or the pace completely collapses
scenarios.body: The beginners chase nature means mistakes are likely, potentially eliminating fancied runners. Mister Frostie or Chichester Park could benefit from a scrappy race where experience matters less.

watchPoints.text: Apple's Of Bresil could be vulnerable to fitness pressure after 370 days off the track
Watch for early pace battle between Jackson Lamb and Apple's Of Bresil burning both out
Howdoyalikeherhome's jumping will reveal if Elliott has solved his previous pulling up issues
Mister Frostie's recent hunter chase form suggests he could cause interference if struggling
Something Noble represents the only four-year-old making his chase debut against older rivals

races.name: GUY Clothing & KODE Clothing & Footwear Handicap Chase

runners_data.name: Vina Ardanza
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid chase form for Gordon Elliott, well-suited to this moderate pace scenario with Sean Flanagan's tactical awareness.
runners_data.spotlight: Useful sort for Gordon Elliott early in his career, finished a remote third behind Jonbon and El Fabiolo in a Grade 1 contest at Aintree in 2023; mostly campaigned in points for the last two years, below his best in four outings in that sphere since January.

runners_data.name: Trasna Na Pairce
runners_data.note: Confirmed front-runner who should get uncontested lead, recent Clonmel form shows he handles similar conditions but 0-6 chase record concerns.
runners_data.comment: Hurdle wins at Clonmel last season were over further, the ground should be ideal for him
runners_data.spotlight: Back-to-back hurdling wins at Clonmel last summer; also front-running second behind Bridie's Beau at same venue in a 2m3f novice handicap chase; 0-6 over fences.

runners_data.name: General Clermont
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits the tactical setup, recent Listowel second shows current form and twice-placed course record provides confidence.
runners_data.spotlight: Two chase wins; went close at Listowel in September (2m6f, good to yielding); twice placed from three visits to this track; shaped quite well for this when fourth at Limerick ten days ago on first run after a break; made a lot of the running then, every chance with fitness advanced.

runners_data.name: Andys Flame
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse faces tactical disadvantage with moderate pace, 338 days off and needs-the-run comment raises fitness doubts.
runners_data.spotlight: Ran only twice in 2025, won at Kelso on the first occasion, poor at Cartmel on the second; suited by good ground; may need the run.

runners_data.name: The Dara Man
runners_data.note: Prominent runner but jumped badly on last two starts, lowest official rating suggests he's vulnerable at this level.
runners_data.comment: Modest strike-rate over fences; jumping awry when PU last twice; others preferred
runners_data.spotlight: Modest strike-rate of 3-39 over fences with last win coming over C&D in August 2024; jumped badly when pulled up on final two starts in 2025; possibly needed the run at Limerick ten days ago.

runners_data.name: No Flies On Him
runners_data.note: Hold-up style needs stronger pace than likely here, 156 days since last run and first-time tongue-tie creates uncertainty.
runners_data.comment: Placed once in ten chase starts; let down by jumping on stable debut and PU latest
runners_data.spotlight: Hurdles winner has been placed only twice in ten chase starts; best effort for a long time when going close at Limerick last November; lacks a recent run; first time with cheekpieces.

runners_data.name: Luimneach
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with ordinary chase form, pulled up last time and needs significant pace collapse to feature prominently.
runners_data.comment: Ran his best race over fences so far when second at Down Royal, holds a leading chance
runners_data.spotlight: Twice successful over hurdles; ordinary handicap chase form until second at Down Royal in January; pulled up at Thurles on his final start for the now-retired Des McDonogh; 10lb below hurdles mark; fair chance if replicating his improved display.

runners_data.name: Iamagetaway
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner making stable debut for Elliott, 0-7 chase record despite placed course form limits expectations significantly.
runners_data.comment: Might strip fitter for his recent stable debut at Kilbeggan (2m4f) where he faded late on
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden hurdle winner over 2m4f on good; 0-7 as a chaser but has placed form over C&D; beaten favourite when a fair third here last month on stable debut; ran poorly when again the market leader at Killarney; may have lost confidence after a mistake at the first.

runners_data.name: Bridie's Beau
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse better on heavy ground than today's conditions, new headgear combination adds unknown element to his chances.
runners_data.comment: Poor chasing last twice; has to return to best back over hurdles; 2lb out of the handicap
runners_data.spotlight: Dual hurdle winner up to 2m4f; best chase form last winter was on heavy ground; best hurdles form also on soft/heavy; new headgear combination.

runners_data.name: Charlie Luciano
runners_data.note: Prominent runner but 0-8 chase record and 208 days off make him hard to recommend despite decent hurdles form.
runners_data.spotlight: Four-time hurdles winner achieved a peak rating of 129 in that sphere; 0-8 over fences and rated 114; pulled up at Fairyhouse on final 2025 start, and badly out of form over hurdles before that.

runners_data.name: Gaelic Arc
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with course-and-distance win but flagged as fading in finish, which could be crucial in tactical affair.
runners_data.comment: C&D winner in June; not enjoyed a productive winter but mark has slid for return
runners_data.spotlight: Five-time winner, twice over fences; enjoyed a productive summer last year, scoring over C&D in June before finishing a nose second in a valuable event in Killarney; highly tried later in the year; made mistakes and finished in rear over C&D on return.

runners_data.name: Warriors Wood
runners_data.note: Prominent style fits race shape perfectly, good recent form and trainer's 3/6 strike rate suggest he's well-prepared for this assignment.
runners_data.comment: Relishes good ground, won twice last summer; unseated on chase debut lto, running well
runners_data.spotlight: Relished good ground last summer when winning over hurdles at this course and Ballinrobe and ran well in handicap hurdle at Downpatrick off 110; unseated when in contention three out at Tramore on chase debut; clear of the third when no match for a warm favourite over C&D 16 days ago; could be hard to beat now.

races.paceDynamic: Trasna Na Pairce will break fast and make the running as the only confirmed front-runner in this field, with Vina Ardanza, General Clermont and Warriors Wood likely to sit prominently in the early stages. The pace should be sustainable rather than frantic over this extended trip, allowing the prominent runners to dictate terms without significant early pressure. This tactical setup heavily favours prominent racers and those who can travel well in behind, as they can position ideally behind the pace without having to make up significant ground. Hold-up horses face a tactical disadvantage with limited early speed in the field creating a moderate gallop that won't suit closers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays steady and no sustained challenges emerge until the final half-mile.
scenarios.body: The leaders maintain control throughout with Trasna Na Pairce, Vina Ardanza and General Clermont able to dictate ideal fractions. Those positioned prominently can kick clear from the last fence while hold-up horses struggle to make up ground on the moderate early gallop.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Challenge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly pedestrian and the race develops into a sprint finish.
scenarios.body: Hold-up horses get the slow pace they need to unleash finishing kicks from off the tempo. Bridie's Beau, No Flies On Him or Andys Flame can produce late surges to overhaul the prominent brigade in a blanket finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Trasna Na Pairce gets an uncontested lead and maintains strong jumping rhythm.
scenarios.body: The Henry De Bromhead runner capitalises on his front-running style by building an unassailable advantage through superior jumping. His back-to-back hurdling wins show he has the engine to sustain a gallop, and the lack of early pace pressure allows him to control the race.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Fading Leaders Scenario
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses go too fast early and weaken dramatically in the closing stages.
scenarios.body: The early leaders pay for overexertion in the first half of the race, creating opportunities for midfield runners. Gaelic Arc and Charlie Luciano, despite their limitations, can pick up the pieces if the pace collapses completely.

watchPoints.text: Trasna Na Pairce could steal this if allowed uncontested lead - monitor if any prominent runners challenge his position early.
Warriors Wood's jumping under pressure given his unseating when in contention last time out at a crucial stage.
Vina Ardanza's stamina over this extended trip after 336 days off, particularly if pace quickens from three out.
The pace development in the first mile - if truly pedestrian it transforms chances of Bridie's Beau and other hold-up horses.
General Clermont's jumping rhythm as he's shown ability to go close in similar company when getting into a flow.

races.name: Follow Kilbeggan On Instagram (Pro/Am) INH Flat Race

runners_data.name: O'Callaghan Can
runners_data.comment: Jet Away gelding, dam Flat and 2m hurdle winner, yard's first bumper runner, watch
runners_data.spotlight: 18-1 and pulled up in a Thurles bumper (2m, soft) on debut in February; rider booking a plus and could improve for better ground but can only be watched for now.

runners_data.name: Corway
runners_data.comment: 4yo tongue-tied for debut and worth a market check; reserve
runners_data.spotlight: Vadamos gelding; dam unplaced 1m-1m3f (RPR 60), sister to French 1m2f winner Melbourne Shuffle, half-sister to Listed-placed 7f 2yo winner Pichola Dance; yard 0-8 in bumpers last five seasons and tongue tied but still worth a market check.

runners_data.name: Gowayoutathat
runners_data.spotlight: 4yo Getaway gelding; third foal; unraced dam out of unraced half-sister to smart 2m4f-3m2f hurdle/chase winner Benvolio; yard 0-22 in bumpers last five seasons; probably best watched unless the market speaks.

runners_data.name: Madison Twist
runners_data.spotlight: 4yo Headman gelding; dam unraced sister to useful French 2m1f-2m5f chase winner Jazz Manouche, out of maiden half-sister to French 2m6f Grade 2 chase winner Kario De Sormain; yard has gone a long time without a winner but makes some appeal on paper so check the market.

runners_data.name: Rarely Miss Taken
runners_data.spotlight: Poet's Word mare; half-sister to winners Bobby's Nelson (useful 2m4f hurdle) and Kalanisi Dubh (2m1f hurdle); dam point winner, sister to 2m3f-3m hurdle/chase winner Prince Massini; market check advised on debut.

runners_data.name: Pack Ball
runners_data.comment: 25,000euros 3yo; fourth foal out of a French 1m2f winner; stable gets bumper winners
runners_data.spotlight: Made a promising start to his career at Killarney when keeping on for a 15l fifth of 15 (2m1f, gd-yld) at odds of 5-1; Patrick Mullins takes over now (5-14 for yard in bumpers) and with improvement likely to be forthcoming, he's the one to beat.

runners_data.name: Rokanako
runners_data.spotlight: 25-1 and weakened quickly in the last 2f when beaten 25l in a Tipperary bumper last July (2m, gd-yld); off since and can only be watched on return from a 332-day absence.

runners_data.name: Getaway Tobin
runners_data.comment: E60,000 Getaway mare, half-sister to top class Monkfish, check the market
runners_data.spotlight: Getaway half-sister to the top class Monkfish but showed little when beaten 40l at odds of 28-1 on debut at Punchestown earlier this month; surely capable of better at some stage but may need more time.

runners_data.name: Ivebeenkewadesert
runners_data.comment: Was 25-1 for Limerick maiden in March, never a factor and finished tailed off
runners_data.spotlight: 4yo Kew Gardens gelding has suffered heavy defeats in maiden hurdles at Limerick (beaten 68l) and Cork on latest (beaten 140l); tongue tie now applied; hard to recommend.

runners_data.name: Ballyteigue Bay
runners_data.comment: Third in Clonmel bumper; never a factor on hurdles bow at Wexford on return in October
runners_data.spotlight: Remote third on debut in a Clonmel bumper a year ago; beaten 68l and pulled up in two maiden hurdles since; off since January; a repeat of that debut run would give him a place chance in this weak race.
